title: Scan.toml [rule] include/exclude (core rules only, no plugins needed)

steps.name: Scan.toml include + CLI exclude
steps.note: From 0.13.0 only ballerina:14 is excluded and every other rule runs, with a warning that --exclude-rules=ballerina:14 overrides [rule] include = ["ballerina:1", "ballerina:13"]. Before, this is the include-and-exclude error.

steps.name: Scan.toml exclude + CLI exclude
steps.note: From 0.13.0 only ballerina:13 is excluded, so the ballerina:1 issues come back, with the override warning. Before, both are excluded.

steps.name: include and exclude in Scan.toml
steps.note: From 0.13.0: Scan.toml has 1 error, Scan.toml:1:1: error: cannot include and exclude rules at the same time.

description: From 0.13.0 a CLI rule option replaces the whole [rule] table of Scan.toml (with a warning), and a [rule] table that sets both include and exclude is a Scan.toml error at its location. Earlier versions add the CLI rules to the Scan.toml ones and fail when the result both includes and excludes rules.
